title: Parkio Daily for October 14, 2026
teaser: EPCOT's UK pavilion closes January 2027; Nomad Lounge adds reservations Nov 8; Six Ravens opens this weekend at Disney Springs.

rides.name: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad
rides.note: Diamond Horseshoe reopened nearby — crowds may shift to Frontierland mid-morning

rides.name: Soarin'
rides.note: Festival crowds tend to arrive late morning; early windows usually shorter

rides.name: Radiator Springs Racers
rides.note: Viva Navidad relocating — slight congestion near Paradise Gardens possible

breaking.title: EPCOT's UK pavilion closing in January
breaking.body: Rose & Crown dining room and pub will close for refurbishment starting January 2027, with Disney moving the closure date earlier than initially announced.

parkioInsight.text: UK pavilion dining reservations may be easier to secure over the next few weeks as word spreads. Book soon if you want a farewell visit before the January refurb.

breaking.title: Nomad Lounge accepting reservations starting November 8
breaking.body: Animal Kingdom's Nomad Lounge will begin taking advance reservations on November 8 and now offers a 49-dollar Annual Passholder food and drink package.

parkioInsight.text: Reservations likely fill fast once live. Check at 6am Eastern on November 8 if you want an afternoon drink spot during your Animal Kingdom visit.

bignews.title: Six Ravens restaurant opens this weekend at Disney Springs
bignews.body: The new Six Ravens dining concept by Gideon's Bakehouse holds its grand opening this weekend after soft-opening in August, with a free collectible for early guests.

parkioInsight.text: Grand opening freebies tend to go quickly. Arriving at Disney Springs when it opens Saturday or Sunday usually improves your odds of snagging the collectible.

bignews.title: Diamond Horseshoe reopened at Magic Kingdom
bignews.body: The Diamond Horseshoe venue in Liberty Square has reopened following a refurbishment, offering table service dining again.

parkioInsight.text: Same-day reservations may pop up in the first few days as the kitchen settles in. Check the app around 11am and 4pm for cancellations if you want to try it today.

bignews.title: Viva Navidad street party relocating at California Adventure
bignews.body: The Viva Navidad celebration moves from the Performance Corridor to a new location for the 2026 Festival of Holidays season at Disney California Adventure.

parkioInsight.text: New performance spots often cause brief bottlenecks as guests adjust. Expect heavier foot traffic near Paradise Gardens during showtimes; plan alternate routes if needed.

bignews.title: Disney Imagination cruise ship name revealed for Japan sailings
bignews.body: Disney Cruise Line announced the name Disney Imagination for the ship launching from Tokyo in spring 2029, offering two-to-three-night cruises.

parkioInsight.text: Booking windows for new ships typically open 18–24 months early. If you're planning a 2029 Japan trip, watch for reservations to launch in mid-2027.

topstories.title: Annual Passholders get 20-percent discount at Disney Store
topstories.body: A limited-time 20-percent discount for Walt Disney World and Disneyland Annual Passholders is now active at Disney Store locations.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-time discounts often end without notice. If you're near a Disney Store or Disney Springs today, bring your pass for the best selection before stock thins.

topstories.title: Character meet location changed at Hollywood Studios
topstories.body: A popular character greeting has moved to a new spot inside Disney's Hollywood Studios, altering guest flow patterns.

parkioInsight.text: New meet locations sometimes post longer waits as guests search. Check the app or ask a cast member near the old spot to avoid wasting time hunting.

topstories.title: 2027 Walt Disney World Marathon medals revealed
topstories.body: Disney unveiled the medal designs for the 2027 Walt Disney World Marathon weekend races taking place in January.

parkioInsight.text: Marathon weekend brings heavier morning crowds to Magic Kingdom and EPCOT in mid-January. If visiting then, plan rope-drop earlier than usual or shift focus to Hollywood Studios.

topstories.title: Monstropolis construction updates visible at Hollywood Studios
topstories.body: New changes are visible at the Monstropolis construction site inside Disney's Hollywood Studios as work continues on the upcoming Monsters Inc. land.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise near Animation Courtyard tends to peak late morning. Plan indoor attractions or meal breaks elsewhere if you're sensitive to jackhammer sounds.

topstories.title: Candlelight Processional dining packages now available
topstories.body: Reservations for 2026 Candlelight Processional dining packages at EPCOT are open, pairing guaranteed show seating with meals at select World Showcase restaurants.

parkioInsight.text: Popular narrators and weekend slots typically book within days. If you want guaranteed seating, reserve this week; standby lines for the processional often stretch two hours.

topstories.title: Winnie the Pooh centennial merchandise arrives at Disneyland
topstories.body: New Pandora charms, rings, and a snow globe celebrating Winnie the Pooh's 100th anniversary are now available at Disneyland Resort.

parkioInsight.text: Anniversary Pandora items often sell out at park locations first. Check World of Disney in Downtown Disney early today if you're collecting the set.

topstories.title: Emperor's New Groove pins debut at Disneyland
topstories.body: Two new limited-edition pins featuring Kuzco, Kronk, and Pacha from The Emperor's New Groove are now for sale at Disneyland Park.

parkioInsight.text: Limited pins can vanish within a week at high-traffic shops. Pin traders usually find the best selection at Emporium or Westward Ho before noon.

icymi.title: Disneyland ticket booth demolition continues
icymi.body: Two additional original ticket booths near the Disneyland main entrance were demolished as part of the ongoing Esplanade expansion project.

icymi.title: Disney and Orlando Magic extend Kia Center partnership
icymi.body: Walt Disney World and the Orlando Magic announced a renewed sponsorship agreement and unveiled a redesigned atrium at the Kia Center arena.

icymi.title: McDonald's releasing Disney villain Boo Buckets
icymi.body: McDonald's Halloween Boo Buckets return October 20 featuring Disney villains including Ursula and Maleficent instead of traditional Halloween characters.

spotlight.title: Disney Believe cruise ship details revealed for 2027
spotlight.body: Disney Cruise Line shared new food, entertainment, and venue details for the Disney Believe, launching in late 2027 with innovative onboard experiences.

parkioInsight.text: New ship itineraries typically appear 12–15 months ahead. If you're eyeing a 2027 or 2028 cruise, start monitoring availability this winter for the best cabin selection.
